name: Border beam
tagline: A little light goes a long way.
description: A travelling glow for cards, inputs and buttons. Five beam shapes, eight palettes, endless ways to draw attention.

fields.name: size
fields.description: Size/type preset Rotate family: 'sm' (compact), 'md' (full border, default), 'line' (bottom traveling). Pulse family: 'pulse-outside' (outward bloom), 'pulse-inner' (contained breathe).

fields.name: colorVariant
fields.description: Color variant for the beam effect - 'colorful': Full rainbow spectrum (default) - 'mono': Monochromatic grayscale - 'ocean': Blue and purple tones - 'sunset': Warm orange, yellow, and red tones

fields.name: theme
fields.description: Theme mode - adapts beam/glow colors for dark or light backgrounds 'auto' detects system preference via prefers-color-scheme

fields.name: staticColors
fields.description: Disable the hue-shift animation for static colors (e.g., monochrome)

fields.name: duration
fields.description: Rotation/travel duration in seconds

fields.name: active
fields.description: Whether the animation is active

fields.name: borderRadius
fields.description: Custom border radius in pixels. When omitted, the component auto-detects the border-radius of the first child element. Falls back to the size preset default if detection fails.

fields.name: brightness
fields.description: Brightness multiplier for the glow effect. Falls back to the type's preset default (1.3 for most types).

fields.name: saturation
fields.description: Saturation multiplier for the glow effect

fields.name: glowSize
fields.description: Multiplies the blur radius of every glow layer, so the halo reads tighter (< 1) or wider and softer (> 1). Each layer keeps its own tuned proportion — the core stays tighter than the bloom — because this scales the presets rather than replacing them.

fields.name: hueRange
fields.description: Hue rotation range in degrees for the hue-shift animation

fields.name: strength
fields.description: Overall strength/opacity of the effect (0-1). Only affects the beam, glow, and bloom layers -- not the children.

fields.name: css
fields.description: Extra CSS appended after the beam's own generated stylesheet, so it can override or add layers and keyframes. Write `{id}` wherever the instance id belongs — the root is `[data-beam="{id}"]`, its layers are the `::before` / `::after` pseudo-elements and `[data-beam-bloom]`, and keyframes are named `*-{id}` — and it is substituted per instance.

name: Thinking orbs
description: Nine particle states give searching, listening and composing a distinct visual language.

fields.name: state
fields.description: Which animation to show.

fields.name: size
fields.description: Tuned size preset — 64 or 20 CSS px.

fields.name: theme
fields.description: Theme mode; `auto` detects from the host project.

fields.name: speed
fields.description: Animation speed multiplier on top of the preset's baked speed.

fields.name: paused
fields.description: Freeze the animation on the current frame.

fields.name: color
fields.description: Optional ink tint — any `#rgb`, `#rrggbb` or `rgb()` color. The orb's depth-shading ramp is preserved on the tint (fading toward black on dark substrates, toward white on light ones), so colored orbs read with the same 3D language as the grayscale default. Omit for the stock grayscale ink.

fields.name: dots
fields.description: Density multiplier for the mode's dot/strand/node counts, applied with the same paired-count scaler the size presets use so the mode keeps its balance. `1` (default) is the tuned look; `0.5` halves density, `2` doubles it. Clamped to a 0.1 floor.

fields.name: dotSize
fields.description: Radius multiplier for every dot, applied with the same scaler the size presets use so near/far falloff keeps its proportion. `1` (default) is the tuned mark; `0.7` reads finer, `1.5` bolder.

fields.name: opts
fields.description: Advanced: raw draw options merged over the resolved preset, last. These are the engine's own knobs, so they reach past the tuned surface — the orbit paths' `ghostA` and `particles` (working), the globe's `scanMul` and `dimBase` (searching), the constellation's `thr`, `signals`, `lineW` and `spread` (connecting), the plait's `turns` (weaving), the sash's `wobMul`, `bandMul` and `spin` (composing, breathing), and the outline's `spread` and `shape` (shaping — `shape` 0 / 1 / 2 holds the circle, triangle or square instead of cycling). Unknown keys are ignored; a key the current state does not read does nothing.

fields.name: frame
fields.description: Escape hatch below `opts`: replace the state's geometry outright. The function gets `(size, t, opts)` and returns the frame to paint — the same contract every built-in mode implements (see `MODE_FRAMES` and the helpers exported alongside it). The painter, theme, tint, pause and offscreen handling all stay the library's.

fields.name: gravity
fields.description: Gravity: the orb pulls at the pointer. As the pointer nears, a raster of the platform's cursor is drawn in its place with its body warped toward the orb — the tip stays put, nothing rotates or scales. Needs the platform's real pointer raster (`gravity.sprite`, or `setGravitySprite`) or it stays off; off automatically under reduced motion, forced colours, coarse pointers, zoom, and over anything but the plain arrow. `true` takes the defaults. See gravity.ts.

name: Metal
description: Liquid metal rings, text and badges with live reflections, cursor light and responsive deformation.

fields.name: variant
fields.description: Variant — controls the shader sampling scale + ring width. - `button` (default): pill-style ring at 1 px wide, scale 1.6 - `circle`: compact circle with a 2 px ring, scale 1.3

fields.name: preset
fields.description: Color preset. All three presets ship both dark and light mode tunings — `theme` picks the right side at runtime.

fields.name: theme
fields.description: Theme mode. `'auto'` (default) resolves via `matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)')` and switches live when the OS theme changes. Pass `'dark'` or `'light'` to pin a specific mode.

fields.name: strength
fields.description: Effect strength (0..1). Multiplies the shader bitmap opacity and the glow SVG alpha. The shader continues to animate at full intensity at any value; only the rendered alpha onto the host is scaled. Lighter values let the underlying child surface show through more strongly.

fields.name: glowGain
fields.description: Multiplier on the glow only (halo + catch-light), on top of `strength`. Use it when the shader runs at low `strength` but the glow should still read — e.g. metal text. Clamped to 0..1 after multiplying.

fields.name: paused
fields.description: Pause the shader animation. The visible canvas keeps the last painted frame so the metal silhouette stays on screen.

fields.name: borderRadius
fields.description: Optional explicit border radius (CSS px). When omitted, MetalFx reads the computed border-radius of the wrapped child each resize.

fields.name: normalizeHostStyles
fields.description: When true, MetalFx normalizes the host element's outer chrome (border / outline / box-shadow) so user-provided component styles don't clash with the metal ring. Inner fills, typography, and content remain untouched.

fields.name: reflectionTargets
fields.description: Neighbour elements that should receive a soft proximity reflection of the metal effect. Reflections only render when the resolved theme is `dark` — pass-through in light mode (no DOM scan, no per-frame work). Pass refs to the sibling DOM elements you want to receive the reflection (chips next to a send button, search field next to an Upgrade pill, ...). A target that *contains* the wrapped element (its parent card, say) receives the reflection on both the nearest vertical and horizontal inner edges. Pair with `{ ref, strength }` to keep that subtle.

fields.name: disableGlow
fields.description: Disable the wandering halo overlay. The shader ring still renders.

fields.name: innerShadow
fields.type: boolean | { offsetY?: number; blur?: number; alpha?: number; color?: string }
fields.description: Light rim along the top inside edge of the ring — an inner shadow from above, like the one on metal text. `true` uses the design defaults (white 90 %, offset 1 px, blur 0.5 px); pass an object to tune.

fields.name: shaderScale
fields.description: Override the shader sampling scale. Larger values zoom into the shared shader (visibly bigger pattern features); smaller values zoom out. Defaults to the variant's baseline (1.6 for `'button'`, 1.3 for `'circle'`) multiplied by `scale`.

fields.name: ringCssPx
fields.description: Override the ring thickness in CSS pixels. Defaults to the variant's baseline (1 for `'button'`, 2 for `'circle'`) multiplied by `scale`.

fields.name: scale
fields.description: Master scale multiplier for every absolute-pixel constant the engine uses internally. Set this when you render the wrapped element at a non-1× size (e.g. inside a CSS `zoom: 2` container, or when you've doubled all your Tailwind sizes by hand). It scales: - shader sampling (so pattern features grow proportionally) - ring thickness on the canvas - glow SVG stroke widths, blur radii, fade-circle radius, and the small inset/outward offsets that position the catch-light - reflection canvas stroke band, border-highlight thickness, and the reference draw width baseline

fields.name: mask
fields.description: Custom alpha mask painter. When set, the shader is kept only where the mask paints (device px, origin at the wrapper's top-left) and the ring punch is skipped — for metal-filled text or glyphs. Pair with `disableGlow`; the glow assumes a ring perimeter.

fields.name: glowMode
fields.description: How the glow is placed when `mask` is set. `'mask'` (default) samples points inside the mask and clips the halo to it — right for metal text. `'ring'` keeps the rounded-rect perimeter behaviour — a halo along the element's edge — for a full-fill mask like a badge.

name: Gooey
description: Merge, morph, move, melt and bend. Liquid silhouettes carry crisp, readable content.

fields.name: blur
fields.description: Goo blur sigma in px — how far apart pieces start bridging. Default 6.

fields.name: contrast
fields.description: Alpha-contrast slope — how sharp the liquid edge is. Default 18.

fields.name: fill
fields.description: Fill of the liquid surface. Any CSS color, `var()` welcome. Default '#fff'.

fields.name: shadow
fields.description: `box-shadow` syntax; rendered on the MERGED silhouette. `inset` layers paint inside the liquid edge (inner rings / top highlights).

fields.name: filterPadding
fields.description: Extra filter-region slack in px for blobs travelling outside the group box. Default 24.

fields.name: waviness
fields.description: Max px the liquid boundary undulates — the silhouette (and its shadows) run through a gentle noise displacement, so edges read as fluid instead of geometric. 0 (default) keeps the calm edge.

fields.name: wavinessFreq
fields.description: Noise frequency of the undulation; lower = longer, lazier waves.

fields.name: filter
fields.description: Escape hatch: raw SVG filter primitives that REPLACE the goo chain (`blur`, `contrast`, `waviness` and the SVG half of `shadow` are then yours to reproduce). The input is `SourceGraphic`; the last primitive's output is what paints. Inset and spread shadows normally read a binarised `shape` result — keep that name if you keep them.

fields.description: Playground recipe field: props applied to each Liquid.Item child, not to the Liquid group. The generated code places these on the child.

itemFields.name: melt
itemFields.description: Tuning for effect="melt": the image source (auto-detected from a child when omitted) plus the melt's physics.

itemFields.name: dissolve
itemFields.description: Melt this item's imagery into a touching neighbour at the contact point — a liquid warp, not a blur. Orthogonal to `effect`: it describes what your CONTENT does where two surfaces meet, not how the surface moves. `true` for the tuned look, `0..1` to scale it, or the raw `DissolveOptions` for full control (wire `active` to your drag).

itemFields.name: x
itemFields.description: Component-driven position: the library animates both the element and its liquid in perfect sync. Omit x/y and animate the child yourself (CSS, Framer Motion, …) — the liquid follows automatically when the effect needs it, or with `observe` for plain merge.

itemFields.name: transition
itemFields.description: Spring preset/config or `{ duration, ease }` for x/y. Default 'smooth'.

itemFields.name: observe
itemFields.description: Plain-merge items animated by YOUR code: makes the liquid follow the child's rendered rect. Implied by `morph.shape`, `dissolve` and effect="move".

itemFields.name: radius
itemFields.description: Override the measured border-radius for the liquid (px).

name: Voice
description: A glow, dotted landscape or wireframe that rises with your voice. Real microphone input or a controlled level.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Host preset: 'default' (chat input), 'pill' (recording pill) or 'mobile' (bottom of a phone screen). Sets the defaults of the geometry props below for that host; any prop you pass still wins.

fields.name: look
fields.description: How the voice is drawn: coloured light, or a surface of dots or lines that the voice raises and gravity brings down.

fields.name: dotSize
fields.description: Dot radius, as a multiplier on the tuned size. `look="dots"` only.

fields.name: dotGap
fields.description: Spacing between dots, as a multiplier — below 1 is a denser, finer surface, above 1 a sparser, coarser one. `look="dots"` only.

fields.name: dotShape
fields.description: The dots' shape: round, or square for a pixel grid. `look="dots"` only.

fields.name: lineWidth
fields.description: Line width, as a multiplier on the tuned width (lines thin out into the distance). `look="lines"` only.

fields.name: lineGap
fields.description: Spacing between lines, as a multiplier — the rows and the columns alike. `look="lines"` only.

fields.name: linePattern
fields.description: Which way the lines run: across the surface, into the depth, or both. `look="lines"` only.

fields.name: seeThrough
fields.description: Draw the lines as a wireframe: those behind a raised ridge show through it instead of being hidden by it. `look="lines"` only.

fields.name: texture
fields.description: Organic texture, 0–1: a slow ripple the flow carries across the surface. 0 is a still sheet that only the voice moves. Dots and lines.

fields.name: gravity
fields.description: How hard the surface falls when the voice drops, as a multiplier on its gravity. Lower floats down, higher drops like sand. Dots and lines.

fields.name: surfaceHeight
fields.description: How tall the surface stands along the bottom, as a multiplier — how far back the sheet runs, and so how much of the host it covers. Dots and lines.

fields.name: surfaceCurve
fields.description: How far the surface arcs, as a multiplier: its sides and far edge fall away like a horizon. 0 is a flat sheet; below 0 it cups upward instead. Dots and lines.

fields.name: surfaceTail
fields.description: The surface's tails: how far its ends rise toward the corners, as a share of the sheet's height — the ends curl up into the host's corners instead of running flat into its sides. Below 0 they drop away instead. Dots and lines.

fields.name: surfaceTailPosition
fields.description: Where the tails start, as a share of the distance from the centre to the side (0.8 = only the last 20%); they reach their full lift at the edge.

fields.name: surfaceTailCurve
fields.description: Exponent of the tails' rise: 1 a straight ramp, 2 a parabola, higher a hook that stays low and whips up at the edge.

fields.name: surfaceFade
fields.description: How far in from the sides the surface dissolves, as a share of its half-width, 0–1. 0 runs it hard into the edges; 1 fades it from the centre out. Dots and lines.

fields.name: scale
fields.description: Size of the whole effect. Multiplies every pixel dimension at once — lobes, their spacing, the visible range, the bend, the band, the core, the bloom blur, the flow speed — so the glow grows or shrinks as one thing, on top of the type preset and the individual geometry props.

fields.name: stream
fields.description: Audio to react to. When set, the beam analyses this stream (level plus low / mid / high bands) and ignores `level`. Get one from the `useMicrophone` hook or any `getUserMedia` / WebRTC source.

fields.name: level
fields.description: Manual drive, 0–1, used when no `stream` is given. A number re-renders on change; a getter is sampled once per frame without re-rendering.

fields.name: sensitivity
fields.description: Input gain on the analysed audio. The default suits a laptop microphone at conversational distance; raise it for quiet sources, lower it for a close or hot one.

fields.name: threshold
fields.description: Noise gate, 0–1. Levels below it read as silence, so room hum and fan noise do not keep the beam twitching.

fields.name: attack
fields.description: Seconds the glow takes to rise toward a louder level.

fields.name: release
fields.description: Seconds the glow takes to settle after the sound drops.

fields.name: idle
fields.description: Resting presence, 0–1 — how much the beam breathes while silent so it never looks dead. 0 hides it completely between sounds.

fields.name: breatheDuration
fields.description: Period of the idle breathing in seconds.

fields.name: reach
fields.description: How tall the glow grows at full level, as a multiple of its resting height. The rise is centered on the bottom edge.

fields.name: spread
fields.description: How far the glow widens at full level, as a fraction of its resting width. Side lobes drift outward as well, so a loud sound spreads.

fields.name: bands
fields.description: Let the low / mid / high bands move the colored lobes independently (center follows the lows, the sides the mids and highs). With a manual `level` the bands are synthesised from the level, so the lobes still dance. Off, every lobe follows the one level.

fields.name: flow
fields.description: How fast the spectrum travels sideways, in px per second at full level — the lobes slide left to right while a voice is heard and rest when it stops, so every colour takes a turn at the centre. Negative flows right to left; 0 holds the lobes in place.

fields.name: processing
fields.description: Processing state — turn it on once the voice has been captured and something is working on it. The lobes gather into one compact beam that travels the glow's range left to right and back, eased at each end and looped — border-beam's `line` type, confined to the voice glow — and the glow is held lit at `processingLevel` so the beam has colour. Both blend in and out smoothly. The distortion settles out in about a quarter second and stays off while processing.

fields.name: processingDuration
fields.description: Seconds for one pass of the processing beam (left to right, or back again).

fields.name: processingLevel
fields.description: How lit the glow is held while processing, 0–1, as if a voice were speaking at that level.

fields.name: processingEase
fields.description: Seconds the morph between the voice glow and the travelling beam takes, in either direction — the gather, the narrowing and the travel ease in and out over it.

fields.name: processingTravel
fields.description: How far the processing beam travels to each side, as a multiple of half the lobe ring: 1 sweeps the glow's resting spread, lower keeps it near the centre, higher runs it out to the corners.

fields.name: processingCurve
fields.description: How the processing beam eases into each turn of its sweep: 1 runs at a constant speed and turns sharply, 2 slows smoothly into the ends, higher dwells there longer before heading back.

fields.name: cornerFollow
fields.description: How much the coloured glow rides the element's corner arcs while processing, 0–1: 0 keeps it flat along the bottom edge, 1 lifts it along the rounded corner as it passes through. The band line follows the corner either way.

fields.name: colorVariant
fields.description: Color variant for the beam

fields.name: colors
fields.description: Your own lobe colours, centre first then the pairs outward — up to seven, any CSS hex or rgb. Slots you leave out (or that fail to parse) keep the variant's colour for the theme.

fields.type: { core?: string; above?: string; mid?: string; below?: string }

fields.name: bend
fields.description: Bend — how much, in px, the glow's top contour humps up at the centre at full level. fields.description: Opacity of the band, 0 hides it.

fields.name: bandWidth
fields.description: Thickness of the band.

fields.name: bandPosition
fields.description: Height of the band's peak as a fraction of the glow's ceiling, 0.1–1.3.

fields.name: bandCurve
fields.description: Bell exponent: below 2 an exponential, cusp-like rise; 2 a gaussian; above, a flatter top.

fields.name: bandSpread
fields.description: Bell width as a fraction of the glow's half-range: small is a narrow spike with long tails, large a broad dome.

fields.name: bandSkew
fields.description: Asymmetry, −0.6–0.6: positive widens the right side and steepens the left.

fields.name: bandOffset
fields.description: Vertical shift of the whole band line in px; negative sinks it toward the edge.

fields.name: bandTail
fields.description: How far the band's ends rise again toward the corners, as a fraction of its peak, 0–1 — the line opens upward at the edges instead of dying flat.

fields.name: bandTailPosition
fields.description: Where the tail's rise starts, as a share of the distance from the beam's centre to the element's edge (0.85 = only the last 15%); it always reaches the full lift exactly at the corner.

fields.name: bandTailCurve
fields.description: Exponent of the rise: 1 a straight ramp, 2 a parabola, higher a hook that stays low and whips up at the corner.

fields.name: bandTailOverflow
fields.description: Px the band runs past each side of the element, so the hook peaks outside and is cropped by the component's edge. Scales with `scale`.

fields.name: bandAberration
fields.description: Chromatic aberration — how far the red and blue fringes split from the core, 0–1.

fields.name: distortion
fields.description: Distortion — how much the glow under the band warps sideways, 0–1. fields.description: Grain of the distortion's noise: below 1 broad slow waves, above 1 finer ripples.

fields.name: rangeHeight

fields.name: softness

fields.name: coreLight

name: Image
description: An animated pixel mosaic settles into a photograph, with three reveal presets and a complete cycle API.

fields.name: preset
fields.description: Selects which bundled preset to render. - `pixels-organic` - Chromium Flow rendered as a pixel mosaic. - `pixels-mechanic`- Nebula rendered as a pixel mosaic. - `sweep-gradient` - Gradient Sweep rendered as a pixel mosaic.

fields.name: theme
fields.description: Theme mode. `'auto'` resolves via `matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)')` and switches live when the OS theme changes.

fields.name: strength
fields.description: Effect strength (0..2). In 0..1 it multiplies the shader canvas opacity (the shader keeps animating at full intensity; only the rendered alpha is scaled down) — exactly the historical behavior. Above 1 the canvas stays fully opaque and the shader's palette intensity is boosted instead, making the effect markedly more prominent.

fields.name: speed
fields.description: Animation speed multiplier on top of the preset's baked tempo. Scales the effect's whole clock — drift, churn and flicker together — so the character of the motion is preserved. `1` (default) is the preset tempo; `0.5` half speed, `2` double.

fields.name: pixelScale
fields.description: Pixel-cell size multiplier for the mosaic effect. Scales the on-screen size of each pixel cell (and the matching reveal dissolve) without touching the preset: - `1` (default) — the preset's authored cell size. - `0.5` — cells at half size (finer grid, effect reads as "zoomed out"). - `2` — cells at double size (chunkier grid, "zoomed in"). Implemented by dividing the shader grid's base cell count by this value, so the shader mosaic and the reveal pixel dissolve stay in lockstep. The grid always keeps a floor of 2 cells, so extreme values are safe.

fields.name: cardBg
fields.description: Card background colour. Accepts any CSS colour string the browser can parse — hex (`#rgb` / `#rrggbb` / `#rrggbbaa`), `rgb()` / `rgba()`, `hsl()` / `hsla()`, named colours, modern `color(...)` syntax — and is applied two ways: 1. Verbatim as the wrapper element's CSS `background`, so the original alpha is preserved visually. 2. Parsed to an opaque RGB triple for the shader's `u_cardBg` uniform, which drives colour-proximity / contrast logic so any shader colours that match the card background get faded out and the effect stays visually balanced. Alpha is intentionally dropped when feeding the shader — the renderer has no source for what's behind a translucent card and can't composite correctly. If precise shader behaviour matters under a translucent surface, pass the opaque colour you want the shader to reason against. Useful for keeping colours in sync when the host card surface changes (e.g. dark-mode card swatch). When omitted, the preset's bundled `cardBg` (always opaque hex) is used.

fields.name: colors
fields.description: Optional palette override for the running effect (up to 7 CSS colors, one per shader palette slot). A slot with a value replaces the preset color verbatim; `null` / `undefined` slots keep the preset color. Pass `undefined` (or omit) to use the preset palette. Useful for re-tinting the effect from external data — e.g. colors sampled from the image being regenerated — while keeping the exact same animation and cell grid.

fields.name: images
fields.description: Image pool used by the reveal animation. Pass a single string to reveal the same image every cycle, or an array for random pick (never repeating the previous index).

fields.name: autoReveal
fields.description: When true, runs the auto-reveal scheduler: shader (random delay) -> reveal -> hold -> hide -> repeat.

fields.name: revealDelayRange
fields.description: Random shader-only delay range in seconds between reveals.

fields.name: revealInitialDelay
fields.description: One-time delay applied before the very first reveal (after `autoReveal` is enabled or `triggerReveal` runs the first cycle). Subsequent reveals follow `revealDelayRange`. - `number`: exact seconds. - `[min, max]`: seconds range, randomised once at cycle creation. - `undefined` (default): library picks a small jitter (0-1.5 s) so multiple instances on the same page don't tick in lockstep. Useful for staggering hero cards (e.g. card #2 = `[1, 3]`, card #3 = `[1, 3]`) so they don't all reveal at once.

fields.name: revealHoldMs
fields.description: Time the image stays fully visible after the reveal animation completes, before the hide cross-fade kicks in. - `number` — fixed milliseconds. - `[min, max]` — random milliseconds per cycle, picked fresh each reveal.

fields.name: revealFadeOutMs
fields.description: ms cross-fade back to the shader.

fields.name: borderRadius
fields.description: Optional explicit corner radius (CSS px). When omitted, reads the computed `border-radius` of the wrapped child each resize.

fields.name: paused
fields.description: Freezes the shader and the auto-reveal scheduler.

fields.name: fragmentShader
fields.description: Escape hatch: a replacement fragment shader (GLSL 1.00 syntax, as the bundled one — `gl_FragColor`, `texture2D`). Every uniform the engine uploads keeps its name; the shader is free to interpret them however it likes. The material is shared, so this applies page-wide while set.

fields.name: excludeSrcs
fields.description: Optional callback invoked just before each image pick that returns a list of src strings the cycle MUST avoid this round. Use this to coordinate multiple `<ImageGeneration>` instances that share an image pool so they never display the same image at the same time. fields.name: autoReveal

fields.name: revealDelayRange

fields.description: ms cross-fade back to the shader.

fields.name: paused
fields.description: Freezes the shader and the auto-reveal scheduler.

name: Bot avatars
tagline: A familiar face for every agent.
description: Twenty-two living shapes, five materials, expressive states and a wardrobe of playful accessories.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Body shape, including `arrowhead`, `chat`, `connector` and `bulb` agent mascots. Default `clover`.

fields.name: path
fields.description: A custom body outline: SVG path data in the 100×100 body box, centred on (50, 50), replacing the type's own (and its antennae). The type still sets the face's place, the default colour and the label, so keep the outline solid round the face. Default: the type's outline.

fields.name: face
fields.description: Face kind. Defaults to the type's own.

fields.name: state
fields.description: What the bot is doing: `default` (idle), `working` (hopping, spinning) or `sleeping`.

fields.name: size
fields.description: Rendered size in px, or any CSS length. Default `64`.

fields.name: color
fields.description: Body colour. Defaults to the type's palette colour.

fields.name: ink
fields.description: Face ink. Defaults to dark, or light on a dark body.

fields.name: brightness
fields.description: Lightness of the body colour: 1 as the palette has it, below 1 darker, above 1 lighter (0.5–1.5 is the useful range). Default `1`, or the type's own (the star's is `1.1`).

fields.name: saturation
fields.description: Saturation of the body colour: 1 as the palette has it, below 1 duller, above 1 more vivid, 0.5–2.5. Past 1.5, where most of the palette is already as saturated as a screen shows it, the colour is pushed along its own hue toward its most vivid shade (deepening by at most 15% where the screen cannot show it brighter), the shade side grows richer, and `plastic` and `fabric` keep more of it in the light — highlights, sheen, rim and fur tips stay coloured rather than paling toward white. Default `1.5`, or the type's own (the star's is `1.84`).

fields.name: speed
fields.description: Multiplier on every animation's speed. Default `1`.

fields.name: paused
fields.description: Freeze every animation on its current frame.

fields.name: seed
fields.description: 0–1. Offsets the blink and glance timing so a row of avatars does not blink in unison. Defaults to a value derived from the instance id.

fields.name: shading
fields.description: How the body is lit: `fabric` (default), `plastic`, `crisp`, `smooth` or `flat`. `true` and `false` mean crisp and flat.

fields.name: hat
fields.description: A hat, sitting on the top of the head and turning with it: `beret`, `beanie`, `party` or `crown`. Default `none`.

fields.name: glasses
fields.description: Glasses over the eyes: `round`, `square` or `shades`. Default `none`.

fields.name: headphones
fields.description: Headphones over the head, a cup on either side. Default `false`.

fields.name: bowTie
fields.description: A bow tie under the face. Default `false`.

fields.name: accessoryColor
fields.description: Colour of the hat, the headphones and the bow tie. Default a soft black.

fields.name: shadow
fields.description: Strength of the shadow side, 0–2. Default `0.35` (`1.15` for `fabric`).

fields.name: highlight
fields.description: Strength of the lit side, 0–2. Default `1.3` (`1.45` for `fabric`).

fields.name: depth
fields.description: Thickness of the body, 0.2–2: what shows when it turns or flips. Default `0.65`.

fields.name: roundness
fields.description: `plastic` and `fabric`: the body's profile through its depth, 0–1. At `1` (default) it is inflated like a cushion or a plush toy — thickest in the middle and rounding off to nothing at the outline all round, so a turn shows a round side; toward `0` it becomes a slab with soft edges.

fields.name: furLength
fields.description: `fabric`: length of the pile, 0.3–2.5. Default `1`.

fields.name: furDensity
fields.description: `fabric`: how many fibres, 0.3–2. Default `1.6`.

fields.name: furFuzz
fields.description: `fabric`: softness of the silhouette — the haze of fine hairs standing past it, 0–1. Default `0.9`.

fields.name: furClumps
fields.description: `fabric`: how much the fibres gather into tufts, 0–1. Default `0.4`.

fields.name: furCurl
fields.description: `fabric`: how wavy the fibres are, 0 (straight) – 1. Default `0.7`.

fields.name: furGravity
fields.description: `fabric`: how much the pile hangs, 0–1 — combed down from a parting at the top, lying over the top edge and hanging off the sides and bottom, rather than standing out evenly all round. Default `0.9`.

fields.name: light
fields.description: Where the light comes from, in degrees clockwise from the top. Default `300` (`295` for `fabric`): from the upper left, like a studio key light.

fields.name: rim
fields.description: Width of the lit rim in `crisp` shading, strength of the Fresnel rim in `plastic`, of the back light in `fabric` — the bright rim it wraps round the top and sides, and the glow of the edge's hairs — 0–2. Default `0.5` (`0.6` for `fabric`).

fields.name: backLight
fields.description: `fabric`: where the back light comes from, in degrees clockwise from the top. Default: above the toy, toward the side away from `light`.

fields.name: lightFront
fields.description: `fabric`: how far round to the front the key light sits, in degrees — `0` grazes the toy from the side (dramatic), `85` lights it nearly from the camera (flat). Default `32`.

fields.name: shine
fields.description: `fabric`: strength of the highlights along single fibres where the key grazes the pile, 0–2. Default `0` (off: a soft, matte pile).

fields.name: sheen
fields.description: `fabric`: the smooth, satin sheen over the body's edge — the key's sheen and the back light's band as even gradients, a material shine rather than the fur's own — 0 (matte, only the fibres shine) – 2. Default `0`.

fields.name: backSoftness
fields.description: `fabric`: how soft the back light is, 0–1 — `0` a small source caught on single fibres as crisp bright hairs, `1` a large one, an even glow reaching further in from the edge and fading out gently. Default `1`.

fields.name: spread
fields.description: Reach of the soft shading in `smooth`, width of the highlight in `plastic`, how far the light wraps round in `fabric`, 0.4–2.5. Default `1.55` (`1.6` for `fabric`).

fields.name: pose
fields.type: { yaw?: number; pitch?: number; roll?: number }
fields.description: Holds the body at this orientation, in radians — `yaw` turns it to the viewer's right, `pitch` tips it to look up, `roll` tilts it — in the state's rest pose, overriding the animation's turns, hops and glances (and pointer play) while it is set. For turning an avatar round by hand, as a 3D viewer does; usually with `paused`.

fields.name: interactive
fields.description: Pointer play: the eyes and head follow a pointer that comes near, and a click makes the avatar hop and turn right round. Default `true`.

fields.name: theme
fields.description: The surface the avatar sits on, for touches that have to read against it. `auto` (default) reads an ancestor `data-theme` attribute or `dark` / `light` class, then `prefers-color-scheme`.

fields.name: turn
fields.description: How far the head turns from side to side while idle, 0–2: `1` as the library has it, `0` keeps it facing forward. Default `1`.

fields.name: whirl
fields.description: The whirl round a spin: its strength, 0–2. Off by default (`0`); `1` turns it on.

fields.name: whirlSize
fields.description: Size of the whirl's ring, 0.6–1.6. Default `1`.

fields.name: whirlWidth
fields.description: Thickness of the whirl's trail, 0.4–2. Default `1`.

fields.name: whirlLength
fields.description: Length of the trail round the ring, 0.4–1.6. Default `1`.

fields.name: whirlTilt
fields.description: How flat the ring is seen, 0.5–1.8 (higher is more open). Default `1`.

fields.name: jumpHeight
fields.description: The jump (an idle flip, a click): how high, in body units — the body is 100 tall. Default `26`.

fields.name: jumpTime
fields.description: Seconds the jump spends in the air. Default `0.68`.

fields.name: jumpStretch
fields.description: How much the body stretches in the air, 0–2. Default `1`.

fields.name: jumpSquash
fields.description: How much the body squashes on the ground, before take-off and on landing, 0–2. Default `1.15`.

fields.name: jumpSquashTime
fields.description: Seconds the landing squash takes, from contact to recovered. Default `0.37`.

fields.name: jumpSquashEase
fields.description: How the landing squash plays out: `sharp` (all at once, then eases off), `pulse` (a quick press that recovers without a wobble, the default), `soft` (eases in and out), `bouncy` (overshoots into a stretch and settles).

fields.name: jumpGroundTime
fields.description: Seconds a jump holds its deepest squash on the ground before recovering. Default `0.11`.

fields.name: jumpGroundEase
fields.description: How the weight settles through that hold, in the same shapes as `jumpSquashEase`: the body presses a little deeper and comes back to the held depth, `sharp` at once, `pulse` quickly, `soft` in the middle, `bouncy` with a wobble. Default `pulse`.

fields.name: jumpRiseTime
fields.description: Seconds the body takes to rise from its deepest squash back to its own shape. Default `0.33`.

fields.name: jumpRiseEase
fields.description: How it rises: `sharp` lets go at once and eases in to rest, `pulse` leaves quickly with a long settle, `soft` eases out of the squash and into rest, `bouncy` passes rest into a slight stretch and settles back. Default `pulse`.

fields.name: jumpClickSquashTime
fields.description: Seconds a click's jump takes for its landing squash (an idle jump's uses `jumpSquashTime`). Default `0.24`.

fields.name: jumpSpin
fields.description: Whole turns made in the air, 0–2. Default `1`.

fields.name: jumpLean
fields.description: Degrees of lean into a jump. Default `6`.

fields.name: jumpEvery
fields.description: Seconds between idle jumps, give or take 40 %; 0 for none. Default `8`.

fields.name: jumpLand
fields.description: When the landing squash begins: seconds before touch-down (negative, bracing for the ground) or after it. Default `0`, the moment of contact.
